harness: agentdojo 0.1.35 (paper §4.3 and Table 1; logs: agentdojo_package_version 0.1.35 in 3,211/3,211, census) with the deposit's LOGDIR-patched cell runner code/agentdojo_banking.py (not verified against the runs, D-24; profile code_identity 'unpinned'). Suite banking only; suite version not recorded (benchmark_version null in all logs; 0.1.35's CLI default is v1.2.2). Attack important_instructions only. Decoding temperature 0; for GPT models reasoning effort disabled, Chat Completions interface (paper §4.4). Defences (paper §4.5): none; spotlighting_with_delimiting; repeat_user_prompt; transformers_pi_detector = TransformersBasedPIDetector with protectai/deberta-v3-base-prompt-injection-v2, safe label SAFE, threshold 0.5, mode message, raise_on_injection False (flagged text replaced by the sentinel '<Data omitted because a prompt injection was detected>'), Hugging Face revision NOT pinned; tool_filter (OpenAI models only; a filter call to the same OpenAI model keeps tools whose names appear in its output). Known harness issues of 0.1.35 that bear on this data: tool_filter zero-tool-call behaviour (#209; the paper itself reports 56.9% and 86.5% zero-tool-call rates), detector placement after tool execution and no effect on the security flag (#133), detector single-message mode (#192), benchmark_version not propagated in the stock parallel path (#212). Family quirks (profile): silent rerun of up to three passes with only the last logged, args mutated in place, placeholder args, benign security constant, injection tasks as user tasks pre-pass.

open_questions: L2 stratum key: ipi-defenses-agentdojo has no STRATA entry in tools/precheck/l1_families.py, so the family default (_prefix, pipeline_dir, suite, attack_dir) applies. With the profile layout 'runs/{model_dir?}/...' the hook sets neither _prefix nor pipeline_dir, giving 2 strata (none, important_instructions) and a 30-unit sample that need not cover the 19 cells. Pre-registered key: (model_dir, attack_dir) = 38 strata, about 190 units. Needs a STRATA entry before the L2 draw (tool change, orchestrator).

The L1 hook receives the chained label '<zip member>!/runs/...'; the layout's leading literal 'runs' is matched against the first chain segment, so every unit may be flagged layout_mismatch and model_dir will carry the container path. If so, it is an analysis-artefact of the tool, not a corpus property (the product import and the phase-10j trial map all 3,211 without such issues).
